options=read('/input/options')
result=[]
for c in combinations(options,3):
  sel=list(c)
  sel_ids=[x['id'] for x in sel]
  workers=[x['worker'] for x in sel]
  jobs=[x['job'] for x in sel]
  if len(workers)!=len(list(dict.fromkeys(workers))): continue
  if len(jobs)!=len(list(dict.fromkeys(jobs))): continue
  job_set=[]
  for j in jobs:
    if j not in job_set:
      job_set=job_set+[j]
  if not ('j0' in job_set and 'j1' in job_set and 'j2' in job_set): continue
  requires_ok=True
  for x in sel:
    for r in x['requires']:
      if r not in sel_ids:
        requires_ok=False
        break
    if not requires_ok: break
  if not requires_ok: continue
  conflict_found=False
  for i in range(3):
    for j in range(i+1,3):
      if sel[j]['id'] in sel[i]['conflicts'] or sel[i]['id'] in sel[j]['conflicts']:
        conflict_found=True
        break
    if conflict_found: break
  if conflict_found: continue
  result=sel_ids
  break
